description: An outdoor garden night scene photographed at a low seated eye-level with an off-center thirds composition, the camera looking slightly upward across a close-mown dark lawn at dusk or full night. The setting is a contemporary residential garden with a closely mown smooth lawn as the ground plane. A large rough-hewn granite boulder or fieldstone rock sits centrally in the mid-ground, its grey-brown surface illuminated from below by warm amber light. To the right, the exterior wall of a contemporary residence clad in smooth pale grey limestone or rendered plaster provides a clean architectural backdrop. Dark pine or spruce trees silhouette against the near-black sky in the background left. Three rectangular lantern-form portable or ground-mounted positions of varying scale are distributed across the composition — one large in the foreground left on the lawn, one mid-size elevated atop the boulder, and one smaller placed on a hard paved surface to the right. Each glows with a warm golden-amber inner light through ribbed or fluted vertical glass panels, casting warm amber puddles of light downward onto the grass and the boulder surface. The palette is very dark near-black sky, deep green lawn, warm amber glow from the lanterns, grey stone, and cool grey architectural wall. The mood is moody, atmospheric, and quietly theatrical at full night. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
